claim.claim-text: a motor assembly (410) including a first motor (420) having a drive shaft (422); and a first torque transducer (424) secured to the first motor, the first torque transducer including a first portion secured to the first motor, a second portion, and a body (520) interconnecting the first and second portions, characterized in that: the first torque transducer includes a strain gauge (540) having:

an active strain sensor (542) supported on the body and configured to measure a first strain of the body as the body moves in a first direction in response to a torque of the first motor; and a calibration strain sensor (544) supported on the body in a different orientation than the active strain sensor and configured to measure a second strain of the body as the body moves in a second direction in response to the torque of the first motor.

2. The instrument drive unit according to claim 1, wherein a channel (522) is defined about a central longitudinal axis of the body to enable the body of the first torque transducer to be disposed about the drive shaft of the first motor, wherein a mounting flange (510) and a motor flange (530) are disposed on opposite ends of the body, and wherein the motor flange (530) defines a recess (532).

3. The instrument drive unit according to claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the first torque transducer is configured to determine the torque of the first motor when the first motor is energized and when the first motor is deenergized.
4. The instrument drive unit according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the motor assembly includes a second motor (430) secured to a second torque transducer (434).
5. The instrument drive unit according to claim 4, wherein the motor assembly includes a third motor (440) secured to a third torque transducer (444).
6. The instrument drive unit according to claim 5, wherein the motor assembly includes a fourth motor (450) secured to a fourth torque transducer (454).

7. The instrument drive unit according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the motor assembly includes a mounting plate (404), and wherein the first torque transducer secures the first motor to the mounting plate.

8. The instrument drive unit according to claim 2, wherein the body includes a low strain region (526) and a high strain region (528), wherein the high strain region defines at least one opening through a sidewall of the body and deflects more than the low strain region when the body twists in response to the torque of the first motor, and wherein the high strain region is in the form of a strut (529) that extends between the mounting flange and the motor flange.
9. The instrument drive unit according to claim 8, wherein the active strain sensor measures deflection of the high strain region.
10. The instrument drive unit according to claim 8 or claim 9, wherein the active strain sensor measures radial strain of the high strain region.

11. The instrument drive unit according to any of claims 8, 9, or 10, wherein the calibration strain sensor measures strain of the high strain region in response to factors other than radial deflection.

12. The instrument drive unit according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the calibration strain sensor measures at least one of thermal expansion of the body, axial tension in the body, or compressive forces in the body.
13. The instrument drive unit according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the calibration strain sensor is oriented perpendicular to the active strain sensor.
14. The instrument drive unit according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the strain gauge includes integrated electronics.
15. The instrument drive unit according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the strain gauge is disposed on at least one of an inner surface of the body or an outer surface of the body.
